# Edify Education
> India's independent online degree comparison platform. We cover 143 UGC-DEB universities offering online MBA, MCA, BBA, BCA, BA, MA, B.Com, M.Com and MSc programmes.
> All data is independently verified. No paid university partnerships and no referral commissions.

## Key Facts
- 143 universities covered, each carrying UGC-DEB entitlement for at least one online programme
- UGC-DEB entitlement is granted per university, per programme, per academic session, and is not a permanent institutional badge
- NAAC grades below are printed only where an accreditation record confirms them and the cycle has not lapsed
- NIRF ranks always state their category; a Management rank and a University rank are different tables and are not interchangeable
- Independent platform, no paid rankings, no referral commissions
- Platform URL: https://edifyedu.in
- Fees change between intakes. Verify any figure against the university's own portal before acting on it.

- How to check UGC-DEB approval yourself: https://edifyedu.in/guides/how-to-check-ugc-deb-approval

- UGC Distance Education Bureau programme register: https://deb.ugc.ac.in
- NAAC accreditation database: https://naac.gov.in
- NIRF India Rankings: https://nirfindia.org

## About
Edify Education is an independent research portal for UGC-DEB approved online degrees in India.
We accept no payment from any university and we do not sell ranking positions.
Rankings cite NIRF with the category named; accreditation cites NAAC with its validity date.
Contact: hello@edifyedu.in
